query_payload.rationale: Add packing, adaptive-shell geometry and chemistry-aware contact/electronic descriptors beyond Magpie; sample sparse rare-element chemistries and binaries.
Add packing, contact strain, adaptive coordination, bond chemistry and atomic hardness beyond Magpie; sample sparse Be/Hf/Tb, rare-earth and non-oxide alkali chemistries.
Complement Magpie with packing, local geometry, chemical ordering and atomic-energy bond contrasts. Sample underrepresented rare-element and halide chemistries highlighted by validation errors.
Add packing, local geometry, bond chemistry and charge-transfer descriptors beyond Magpie; sample sparse Hf/Be systems, rare-earth intermetallics and complex oxides.
Add packing, contact strain, local chemistry, and angular order beyond Magpie; sample rare-earth nonoxides, B/Be/Hf compounds, and halides to address observed error clusters.
Retain existing terms; add adaptive local chemistry, packing, charge balance and symmetry. Sample halides, boride/alkali mixtures and undercovered f-block chemistry.
Retain core descriptors; add local charge balance, chemical order and packing measures. Sample borides/intermetallics, halides and underrepresented oxides.
Retain charge and overlap signals; add occupancy-aware shell geometry, chemical ordering and atomic charge-transfer scales. Sample borides, rare-metal compounds and halides.
Retain chemistry descriptors; add radius-scaled geometry, contact mixing, polarity and anisotropy. Sample scarce B/Be/Hf chemistries and complex oxides.
Retain six descriptors; add packing, adaptive-shell geometry, chemical ordering and local charge constraints. Query scarce B/Be and chemistry implicated by validation errors.
Add scale-free coordination, bond strain, local chemical contrast and angular geometry; sample scarce B, halide/nitrogen chemistry and oxygen-free donor-rich compounds.
Retain chemical baselines; add local bonding, packing, charge compatibility and geometric heterogeneity. Sample metal-rich compounds, rare-earth oxides and simple halides.
Radius-scaled contacts, chemical order, atomic charging and local geometry complement composition. Sampling emphasizes electropositive alloys, halides and nitrogen mixed-anion chemistry.
Combine charge balance with adaptive coordination, local bonding, angular geometry and network periodicity; query molecular-anion, metal-rich and sparsely sampled chemistries.
Retain seven descriptors; add packing, shell geometry, chemical ordering and local charge-transfer measures. Sample electropositive intermetallics, N–O compounds and rare-earth chemistry.
Retain chemistry terms; add packing, local bonding, charge-transfer and periodic-network descriptors. Sample N-rich compounds, alkali intermetallics and small-cell halides.
Add local packing, coordination, chemical ordering, and environment-aware charge descriptors; sample N-rich salts, halides, and electropositive mixtures.
Retain chemical-contact features; add packing, adaptive coordination, angular anisotropy and local charge descriptors. Sample nitrogen, nonoxide metals and rare-earth/halide gaps.
Combine charge-transfer chemistry with packing, coordination, molecular compression and local compensation. Sample nitrogen compounds, low-component halides and oxygen-free alkali chemistries.
Add local bond-capacity imbalance, directional asymmetry, packing and isolated-bond signals; sample nitrogen and bromide chemistry to address prominent residual motifs.

final_fill.method: uniform without replacement on remaining POOL; fixed arm/seed RNG
